protocol: Screen reference protocol, v1.6 prospective round 2
boundary_match_rule: Sorted, earliest eligible, one-to-one matching at inclusive ±1 second. Agreement uses untouched independent label timestamps.
roi_match_rule: Maximum cardinality one-to-one pairing at inclusive ±1 second and IoU ≥0.5. Ties favor greater summed IoU and smaller summed absolute time difference. Indexes are one-based in the original files.
transcription_match_rule: Directional Levenshtein counts over geometrically matched independent regions. Normalize NFKC, remove all whitespace and preserve case. Counts include any visible text scope mismatch between the chosen boxes.

preselected_shared_crop_agreement.reason: Separate shared-crop transcriptions do not appear in the original independent annotation files. The shared source-only set is frozen for independent transcription before inference.

source_timing: Timestamps are the first relevant observed frame at native inspection cadence of one sample per second. Within-second ordering and a one-sample exposure duration are unresolved.

a_only.description: A newly drawn polygon over Central and South Asia displays its settled area measurement.
Delete all removes every drawn geometry from the measurement map.
A rotated rectangle settles over Kazakhstan and nearby areas before its area is computed.
The rotated rectangle’s final area readout settles after the adjustment.
The selected circle settles after being repositioned, with a changed area and outline.
Dragging a vertex leaves a pointed extension on the circle and a changed area.
Returns from the custom-font example to the home page and settles on the Examples gallery.

b_only.description: The presentation begins with its dedicated title slide on maplibre-gl-terradraw.
Clears the sample geometries and their measurement labels from the map.
The angled rectangle over Central Asia finishes changing and shows its final area.
Returns to the main Terra Draw page after the custom-font example and scrolls toward the gallery.
